instruction: Find the payment methods information page on the website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to find information about payment methods. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains 'payment' pattern.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern 'payment' will match URLs related to payment methods or payment FAQs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to 'find the payment methods information page'
Getter (active_tab_info) successfully extracts the active tab URL from the browser state
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
Expected pattern 'payment' is semantically appropriate - will match URLs containing payment-related paths (/payment, /payment-methods, /payments, etc.)
Data flow is correct: active_tab_info returns dict with 'url' field -> metric extracts URL and checks pattern -> returns 1.0 if match
No critical logical flaws or edge case issues identified
Pattern is simple but appropriate for 'easy' difficulty task - successfully distinguishes payment pages from non-payment pages
